evals.prompt: When I publish, the screen hangs with no error. I expected it to leave draft. Diagnose this — do not fix it.
evals.expected_output: Agent writes the eight-section chat report in the prompt language. Sections 2–3 have no engineering jargon (no HTTP, payload, ORM, test runner, file paths, class names).
